scope: Proposition 3.1 (The completed tower) of the manuscript “A rational obstruction to strong chromatic splitting at height three” (preprints/A-rational-obstruction-to-strong-chromatic-splitting-at-height-three-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 318 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6d0bd23f35dc42a1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The field L̂ is perfectoid of characteristic p, and is isomorphic, as a valued field over k, to the completed perfection of a Laurent-series field: L̂ ≃ ⎛ ⎝ ⋃ r≥0 k((z1/pr )) ⎞ ⎠ ∧ . There is a G-equivariant identification of v-sheaves over Spd k Spd L̂ ≃ Surj(E0 3 , E0 2 ). Consequently Y = [Spd L̂/G] classifies surjections E3 ↠ E2 between Pn-structured forms. In particular Y carries the universal surjection used below. Let S3 = ker N3 and T3 = P3/S3 = Z× p . Then [Spd L̂/S3] ≃ BC(−1/2)∗ as v-sheaves, with the following residual P2 ×T3-action. On extension classes in Ext1 (E0 2 , O), write λ∗ for pushout by λ on O and b∗ for pullback by b on E0 2 . For the framing action f ↦ bfg−1 and a = N3(g), the action is (b, a) · ξ = ( aN2(b)−1) ∗ (b−1 )∗ ξ. In particular, the T3-action is pushout by a on the kernel. Only this restriction of the action on the extension chart is used below.
